//! @residency-write
//! RED fixture for `residency-pin` — the TENANCY write-boundary (layer-3) slice (P-CP-03 / P-026).
//! The lint MUST reject this. The cell write boundary sets the row's `region` from an UNTRUSTED
//! REQUEST FIELD (`req.region`) instead of the harness-threaded CELL region — a forged request
//! could land this tenant's row in the WRONG region: the cross-region-write bug class the
//! `residency-pin` rule's §4.3 write boundary forbids (refined-arch tenancy §4.3/§5.3 layer 3;
//! ADR-11). Every write must pin `row.region == cell.region` with the cell's region injected by the
//! harness, never copied from the request. This is the CP-D3 lint leg — a region-mismatched write
//! must fail the build.
pub async fn write_artifact(ctx: &CellCtx, req: &WriteRequest, store: &TenantStore) -> Result<()> {
    let row = ArtifactRow {
        tenant_id: req.tenant_id,
        region: req.region,
        payload_ref: req.payload_ref,
    };
    store.insert(row).await
}
